title: Rotary knob
description: What the knob controls and how. Changes apply after a restart.

keys.name: autopilot_id
keys.title: Autopilot id
keys.description: The autopilot in the SignalK v2 autopilot API, the id after /autopilots/ (not _default on this boat).

keys.name: heading_source
keys.title: Heading source
keys.description: navigation.headingTrue (shown as degrees true) or navigation.headingMagnetic (degrees magnetic).

keys.name: anchor_radius
keys.title: Default anchor radius
keys.description: The watch circle radius used when arming, until the dial changes it.

keys.name: light1_name
keys.title: Light 1 name
keys.description: Shown on the knob, upper case, up to 15 characters.

keys.name: light1_path
keys.title: Light 1 SignalK path
keys.description: Empty = channel not used. A relay path takes 1 or 0, a dimmer path a ratio 0 to 1.

keys.name: light1_form
keys.title: Light 1 type
keys.description: onoff = a relay (turn right is on, left is off). level = a dimmer.
